text: Take a slow, steady breath in, and let it go.
Let your body settle into the space beneath you.
Another slow breath in, and as you exhale, gently release any holding in your shoulders,
Your jaw, your chest, allow yourself to just arrive.
Feel your breath beginning to settle into its own rhythm, natural, easy, unforced,
As your body softens, your awareness begins to expand just a little, like a quiet room
Opening inside you, a room where clarity can be felt, and confidence
Can rise without effort.
You don't have to make anything happen.
Feel the length of your spine, the quiet support running through it.
This is your inner structure, steady, present, unmoving.
Let your breath flow up through the spine on the inhale and down through the spine on
The exhale, as if you're tracing a gentle current of strength within you.
And as this current moves, you might notice a subtle shift.
A soft sense of capability, gathering, centering.
Rooting itself inside you.
Confidence isn't loud.
It doesn't need force.
It doesn't push.
It simply is, a quiet knowing that rises from steadiness.
Feel the center of your chest soften, and imagine a gentle warmth beginning to form
There, small at first, but steady.
Consistent.
Real.
With each inhale, this warmth grows just a little, and with each exhale, it spreads through
Your body.
A calm certainty moving outward, filling your arms
Your stomach, your legs, your whole being.
Whole being.
Let yourself breathe into that warmth.
Let it fill the spaces that once felt unsure.
Let it settle into places where you held doubt.
Let it become the quiet foundation beneath your next steps.
You don't need to know how confidence forms.
Just allow it to take shape inside you.
Allow it to reveal itself in its own way.
In its own time.
A steady presence.
A grounded strength, a soft, internal yes.
As this confidence grows, you may begin to sense your breath feeling brighter, your posture
Your senses subtly lifting.
Your awareness becoming clearer.
Your mind opening to what's possible.
Not rushed.
Not forced, just gently awakening.
Take a slow breath in, and feel this confidence rising through your entire body.
From your feet, through your spine, into your chest
Up behind your eyes, into the space above your head,
A whole body presence, a whole body knowing.
You can meet what comes with clarity.
You can step forward with steadiness.
You can trust the strength that lives in you, the strength that is you.
Rest in this sense of confidence for a few moments, letting it settle, letting it root,
Letting it become natural.
And when you're ready, bring a gentle awareness back to your breath.
Feel the ground beneath you.
Feel the space around you.
Feel the quiet strength within you
Still here
Still steady
Still yours
Take one more slow inhale and let it go.
You can return to this inner confidence anytime.
It lives in you.
It supports you.
It rises with you.
